title: Camden Derby - Heritage Brown
description:
The ideal all-weather shoe. Stroll in style and don't fret about your shoes getting wet. Our Heritage Brown leather is highly water resistant and the storm welt / Vibram mini-lug combination is built to take on the elements. The Derby style is considered a little more casual with it's blucher type lacing and pairs perfectly with denim or chinos. This is the perfect shoe at the office or when you're out with some friends on the weekend. We designed and crafted the Camden Derby with versatility in mind.

The uppers are crafted from Heritage Brown Leather which is durable, low maintenance, and highly water resistant. They are fully lined to give these shoes all of the structure and support you'd expect from footwear of this quality. The Vibram #430 mini lug sole with leather midsole and leather storm welt adds a nice touch of sophistication without sacrificing practicality. The Vibram soles stand tough in just about any condition. Blake Welt Stitch Construction, Made in Maine, USA.
